days.source_has_no_values: 2026-11-17 to 2026-11-25 (2 to 6 traded rows each left null by value_unit_mismatch; the rest filled)

hosted_facts_before_fix.root_cause: trade date 2026-11-13 is eligible (all partitions >= it indexed) and files_by_date holds 201 files (346 MB) for it; _complete_day read them all in one call and returned nothing when the 20 s budget hit (522 MB RSS growth with the whole day of records in memory), so no call ever progressed; the next unindexed partitions (2026-11-12 120 MB, 11-11 143 MB) would hit the same wall in _index_partition, which read a whole partition with no check inside

read_rates_read_only.how: python3 in the running container under nice -n 10, reading only (DailyBarsStore pointed at a nonexistent root, extract_rows only); peak RSS of the measuring process 66 MB

fix.unit_of_progress: one run file (at most 4 MB on hosted); no byte offset needed
fix.index: state['indexing'][partition] = {files, dates} for a partition read part way; saved when the call stops inside it; finished partitions move to state['indexed'] with dates and files counts; v1 state files without 'indexing' load unchanged (hosted keeps its 10 indexed partitions)
fix.day: daily_bars_completion_stage/<trade date>.json holds done file paths, compact bars {market|symbol|date: [open, high, low, close, volume, traded_value]}, conflicted keys and rejection counts; applied once with DailyBarsStore.complete_day_values when every indexed file of the day is staged, then deleted; stages of days no longer stored are deleted at the end of a call
fix.merge_rule: per file extract_rows, then DailyBarsStore._merge_copies across files (larger volume wins, tie later); a price disagreement inside a file (re-extracted per record to find the key) or across files refuses the key as conflicting_duplicate, counted once, exactly as one extract_rows pass over all files
fix.progress_guarantee: out_of_budget checks memory first always, seconds only after report['progress'] > 0, so a call stopped on seconds has always saved at least one file; a memory stop with no progress stays a visible failure (failed=true)
fix.writer_loop: MarketDataStorageWriter continues while a call stopped on days/seconds/partitions and report['progress'] > 0 (5 s apart, at most 400 calls)
fix.no_reread: a day whose retained files were all staged gets 'complete' or 'source_has_no_values' (filled_rows recorded); the old 'partial' status re-read the whole day on the next call to fill nothing
unchanged_guarantees: only null values filled, a non-null value never overwritten
one new manifest generation and digest per filled day
memory guards growth 768 MB and ceiling 5120 MB against the 6 GiB limit

measurement_hosted_shape.fixture: real hosted run files of partitions date=2026-11-13 (201 files, 345 MB) and date=2026-11-12 (44 files, 120 MB) and the real stored days 2026-11-12 (7,718 traded rows) and 2026-11-13 (7,467), all null volume/value, copied read-only into a local scratch root

result.note: the left-null rows are value_unit_mismatch / bad_close rejections, not lost work

residual_findings: The newest write-date partition is indexed while it is still being written; files added later the same day are never indexed (pre-existing; harmless today because the day is completed from the first file, but a later run file for that day is not read).

A day that reached complete/source_has_no_values is only revisited when its manifest digest changes; run files for an old trade date written later (backfill) are indexed but do not re-open that day (pre-existing).
The test interpreter provided to workers (PANTHEON_DEPENDENCY_PYTHON) has no pyarrow, so the daily bars tests skip there; CI must run them in an interpreter with pyarrow.
